description: NarrativeTrace for Python records each traced call, its parameters and its result as log lines through the standard logging bridge, and writes a value-free structural trace per test. Install from PyPI: narrativetrace (core) and narrativetrace-pytest (pytest plugin).
rules: Install with `uv add narrativetrace` and `uv add --dev pytest narrativetrace-pytest`; `uv run narrativetrace init --dry-run` previews the agent skills it would write to .agents/skills and .claude/skills.
Pick the integration with documentation/choosing-an-integration.md; every path records through one capture model, trace_object(obj, context) being the core primitive.
Values matching the redaction rules are replaced with [REDACTED] before any output; keep secrets out of traced parameters and apply not_traced to the real parameter.
Prove redaction with a test that asserts "[REDACTED]" in the rendered trace; importing not_traced or narrated protects nothing by itself.
Only wrapped or intercepted code appears in a trace; read the run's actual trace output before describing what the application did.
documentation/llms.txt is the curated reference; documentation/recipes/ holds complete worked examples by problem.
